`pinned="start"` keeps the first column in view while the rest scrolls, and `pinnedEdge` shows a shadow once content slides under it.
`size="sm"` tightens row height and padding for dense data.
`stickyHeader` keeps the header in view in a height-limited table, and adds a hairline under it once rows scroll beneath.
